scenario_description:
Objective: Use a same-day quick-lube voucher to add a no-cost undercarriage rinse to the pickup after routine service.
Emerging Need: A preview is only speculative until the qualifying service, afternoon route timing, exact voucher terms, and lane availability align.
Decision Context: The pickup service workpad supplies the loyalty ID, tag detail, voucher desk address, and free-only preference needed to distinguish a reversible reservation from paid wash upgrades.
Consequence: Timely use could add a small maintenance convenience without changing the service or spending; ignored or found after the desk closes, the oil change and ordinary plans remain as they were.

parameter.subject: Route-day wash voucher preview
parameter.body: Today only, Dusty Plains may release a limited batch of no-cost undercarriage rinse vouchers for customers who complete qualifying pickup service on Jan. 3. Final terms and claim instructions will be posted late this morning after the service counter count is reconciled.

parameter.description: Routine oil change and inspection for personal pickup

parameter.title: After-route stop near North Van Buren shops
parameter.description: Synced personal errand note: grocery pickup at the North Van Buren shops; Dusty Plains Wash is two blocks away.
parameter.location: North Van Buren shops, Enid, OK

parameter.subject: Jan. 3 undercarriage rinse voucher terms
parameter.body: Qualifying Jan. 3 quick-lube customers may claim one no-cost undercarriage rinse voucher for activation at Dusty Plains Wash today between 3:30 PM and 4:30 PM. Claims must reach the voucher desk by 1:00 PM with the service receipt reference, loyalty ID, customer name, and pickup tag. The voucher has no cash value and does not require a paid wash bundle.

parameter.content: Voucher lane update: reserved undercarriage-rinse activations are moving with no wait until 4:30 PM. Staff match the reservation name to the pickup tag at the lane; no paid upgrades are handled there.

parameter.subject: Jan. 3 rinse voucher desk closed
parameter.body: The Jan. 3 undercarriage rinse voucher allotment closed at 1:00 PM and the remaining same-day activations have been assigned. Late claims cannot be added to today's voucher lane.
